newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian Nov output down 3.6 pct mo/mo, up 2.3 y/y.
newsitem.headline: Croatian Nov output down 3.6 pct mo/mo, up 2.3 y/y.

text.p: The State Bureau of Statistics issued the following economic indicator details.
CROATIA INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT NOVEMBER OCTOBER NOV '95

NOTES -- January-to-November output rise was put at 3.2 percent compared to the same period of 1995. Capital goods output rose 12.9 percent, production materials 3.4 percent and consumer goods 0.7 percent to the end of November.
Data include estimates for Serb-held territory, where production amounted to two percent of the total before 1991. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
